records.rationale: The declaration token is the class variable @@sequence in Billing::Invoice (lib/billing/invoice.rb line 12, 1-based). I inspected every file in the fixture reachable through the require_relative graph plus the app directory (invoice, record, money, auditable, formatting, user, findable, and app/report.rb); no other file contains the token @@sequence. The single semantic usage is the compound assignment `@@sequence += 1` in Invoice.build. Ruby class variables are not importable or re-exportable, so the bindings_optional policy yields no optional binding tokens. No exact-name candidates required exclusion and no required-contract ambiguity remains, so the required set is one location, which is deterministically the definitionUsage.
